text: At Jookran High School for Girls, a sadistic teacher nicknamed Old Fox phones a former pupil to say [a student named Jin-ju is dead but still attending school|threat|the restless dead], and minutes later she is found hanging from a noose. Her replacement, "Mad Dog" Mr. Oh, [beats and harasses the girls|wrong|the powerful abuse their power]. The art student Ji-oh paints in a storeroom said to be haunted, where old yearbooks hold [a pattern of false students every three years|images|books, letters and writing], and a lonely ghost [only wanted someone to love her|wants|to be loved and belong].
